messages:
Lee: quick flag: int4 canary returning toolcall wrapped as single-element array again. sample:

Lee:
```json
[{"action":"call","name":"lookup","arguments":{"id":123}}]
```

Lee: expected single object not array. our strict funcall parser rejects this.

Maria: saw similar on another model. streaming boundary or serializer oddness? :thinking_face:

Simon: drop model/trace?

Lee: canary id=canary-171999, model=raven-lite-int4-v2, kernel=fast-kv, trace=2026-03-21T12:02:03Z

canary-bot: Canary alert: structured-output-parse-failures=1.82% (30m window)

Maria: we have ndjson unwrap but not single-array unwrap. risky: could mask legitimate multi-action responses.

Simon: heuristic: if payload is array length==1 AND object contains keys action/name then unwrap. tag metric parse.unwrap_single_array=true. add config toggle parse.unwrap_single_array=false. tests for multi-action arrays >1.

Lee: +1 to heuristic and tests. also run 1k prompt canary harness to validate.

Simon: grep across canaries for pattern `"[\{\"action\"` -> 89 hits last 24h, majority int4.

canary-bot: Deploying patch unpack-array-fallback v1 to staging at 1719992500

Simon: staging run shows parse_failures down to 0.42% in window. perf impact negligible. :thumbsup:

Lee: filing INFER-7421 for full fix + telemetry. https://redwood-internal/issue/INFER-7421

Maria: I'll own the canary eval run + regression alerts. leaving note: release config parse.unwrap_single_array=false to opt out. thanks team :raised_hands:

Simon: merging after one more review.
